header.description: Discover the powerful features that make our platform the perfect choice for your needs

cards.title: Live Console
cards.description: Monitor your server in real-time with our live console. View logs, warnings, and errors with a single click — plus instant share log for quick support.

cards.title: Plugin Manager
cards.description: Install and manage plugins in one click. Browse Modrinth, SpigotMC & CurseForge directly from your panel — no FTP or manual uploads needed.

cards.title: Mod Manager
cards.description: Seamlessly install and update mods from Modrinth and CurseForge. Filter by loader and version — everything managed from one clean interface.

cards.title: Server Overview
cards.description: Get a full snapshot of your server at a glance — CPU, Memory, Disk, Network, uptime, status, node, and hostname all in one dashboard.
